A CLEARER PICTURE

Know what you’re seeing.

Weather and air quality are model estimates from Open-Meteo and CAMS, not direct readings from on-site sensors.

The page checks the backend every five minutes while open. Each Python instance caches upstream requests for 15 minutes. Cold starts can fetch sooner. No requests means no background refresh.

DuckDB is read-only. The original hourly Prefect job is not running on Vercel. Its stored ML prediction changes only when the warehouse is updated and redeployed.

Network values, available nodes and source labels come from the backend payload. Heat index is not an on-site WBGT measurement.
